summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P MidCap 400 GARP ETF (GRPM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P MidCap 400 GARP index. The fund tracks an index of US mid-cap growth stocks with perceived quality and value characteristics. GRPM was launched on Dec 8, 2010 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: GRPM is an equity ETF with a total of 63 individual holdings. The top holdings are Abercrombie & Fitch Co. stock at 3.22%, Halozyme Therapeutics at 3.13%, InterDigital at 2.82%, Duolingo at 2.72%, and Hecla Mining Company at 2.58%.
